name: Reacts to tile hazards
description: Fire/lava/spark tiles the enemy overlaps apply their element to it (through its reactions table), rate-limited by cooldownMs.

name: Element reactions table
description: When an element hits this enemy, look it up in the enemy's reactions map (kill / stun / knockback / none).

name: Stunnable (sleep + wake)
description: While stunned the enemy does nothing at all; when the stun timer runs out it wakes into wakeTo (patrol, or return for homebound enemies).

rules.note: Even the wake tick skips movement — matches the old engine loop.

name: Chases on sight
description: Forward vision cone: seeing the player escalates to chase; losing them (hidden, smoke, or loseTargetMs without sight) gives up into giveUpTo. Smoke on either end breaks sight.

name: Patrols a route
description: Drifts between its patrol bounds at speed, refusing steps it can't safely take (walls, refused elements, drops deeper than a tile). Blocked both ways = stand still.

name: Returns to its post
description: In the return state, walks back toward its spawn point at speed.

name: Gravity + walking physics
description: Applies gravity and resolves movement against the map. Hitting a wall while patrolling flips the facing.

name: Trappable
description: Walking onto a player-placed trap captures this enemy (removed from play, trap consumed).

name: Brazier flame
description: Water douses a lit brazier; fire relights a cold one. Flowing/pooled water tiles touching it douse it too.

name: Use: swing
description: F swings the item in an arc ahead: lights/scoops the carrier first if it can, otherwise applies the item's element to tiles, enemies, and braziers in reach. Consumables spend themselves on a real effect.

name: Use: splash
description: F splashes the item's element over a wide area ahead (tiles, enemies, braziers), then the container reverts to its empty form.

name: Use: place
description: F places the item in front of the player (spring pad or trap). E takes it back.

name: Use: throw
description: F lobs the item; hold to charge the arc. It bursts into a smoke veil where it lands.

name: Doused by an element
description: Standing in the item's dousedBy element reverts it to its doused form (a lit torch goes out in water) — wherever it sits in the inventory.

name: Lights near fire
description: Just holding this up to any flame (fire tiles, burning tiles, lit braziers) lights it into its lit form — no button press needed.

name: Lights braziers while held
description: Carrying this (a lit fire source) into a cold brazier lights the brazier.

name: Fluid flow (global tunables)
description: Tunables for the fluid sim core. intervalSec = seconds between flow ticks. sideBias = which side fluid tries first when spreading/sliding: alternate (flips each tick, cancels drift), left, or right. recedeMs = how long a cut-off sourced pool takes to fully recede. toyblockPushSec = lean time before a toyblock hops.

name: Heat spread (global tunables)
description: Tunables for fire/lava radiating into neighbors. intervalSec = seconds between spread ticks. chainMeltRange = how many tiles beyond direct lava contact a melt can chain through consecutive meltables (-1 = unlimited, 0 = only tiles touching real lava, N = at most N tiles deep).

name: Element effect verbs (global tunables)
description: Tunables for the effect verbs. energizeMs = how long charge lingers on conductive tiles. freezeSpreadMax / energizeSpreadMax = flood-fill caps for freeze and energize.
